{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABa8yCwQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhEiL6o", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 63, "title": "Add synchronized VMD animation playback to the public Uka and Gene MMD/glTF comparisons (IK/physics off)", "body": "## Problem

The public side-by-side character comparison is static (apart from manually selected Uka expressions). The project already has VMD playback code, and both officially sourced character repositories publish sample dialogue/expressive motions. The next milestone is **actual synchronized VMD playback in the public MMD (direct PMX) vs glTF comparison**, **without IK or physics**. This is a visual/demo feature, not merely a synthetic test page.

**Workflow:** This is an implementation handoff for the designated implementer. The issue author must NOT implement it, create a branch, or open a PR. Implementers follow the normal Issue → implementation → PR flow.

## Key finding: both models have their own sample VMDs

Pinned upstream sources:
- **Uka:** [mmdagent-ex/uka/motion](https://github.com/mmdagent-ex/uka/tree/659f0d1a740fec68bb2817dc9c694a35e7a15f12/motion), with 40 VMD files (39 numbered dialogue motions and `stand.vmd`).
- **Gene:** [mmdagent-ex/gene/motion](https://github.com/mmdagent-ex/gene/tree/c7eace43dffaccff6ad0597433ef85fa57c91e03/motion), also with 40 VMD files.

**Do not assume every file under Uka/motion is model-specific.** Git blob SHAs show, for example, `03_smile.vmd` and `stand.vmd` are byte-identical between Uka and Gene; `01_happy.vmd`, `04_littlesmile.vmd` and `16_thinking.vmd` differ. The currently selected Uka `03_smile.vmd` has the informational VMD model name `ジェネ / Gene`, with many unmatched Uka tracks: see [Uka inventory](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/uka-inventory.json). A motion’s folder/name alone is **not** proof of binding compatibility.

Both upstream READMEs explicitly describe `motion/` as sample dialogue/expression motions. Uka files use CC BY 4.0 and a prescribed credit; Gene also has additional trademark/design use restrictions. Preserve original attribution, source links, usage notices and model-specific rights in existing About & credits and generated asset metadata.

## Expected outcome

For BOTH public character choices (Uka and Gene Light), choose a compatible, pinned official VMD; the left **MMD** (direct PMX via `@takahirox/three-mmd`) and right **glTF** views animate using the SAME source VMD and a **single shared playback clock**. Play/pause/seek/restart/loop yield matching times; visible bone and/or expression changes occur on both sides.

For this issue, **IK and rigid-body physics are strictly OFF on both sides**. Because the goal is an apples-to-apples raw VMD animation comparison, also disable/avoid extra bone append/grant solving and any other deformation family not executed on both sides; document this deliberate first-phase scope. Do not claim original native MikuMikuDance parity.

## Implementation guide

### Motion choice and binding audit

1. Enumerate the upstream motion files at the pinned commits, inspect their headers and track names and compute exact name-based bone/morph match coverage separately for `MS_Uka.pmx` and `Gene_light.pmx`. First investigate **Uka-specific `01_happy.vmd` or `04_littlesmile.vmd`** (not just the shared `03_smile.vmd`), and **Gene's own `01_happy.vmd` or `03_smile.vmd`**. Select at least one representative motion per character with meaningful, actually bound visible movement.
2. Record matched/unmatched/ambiguous bone and morph tracks and whether playback is primarily facial or skeletal. VMD header model name is informational; never treat it as sufficient binding evidence. Missing tracks must not be silently claimed as executed. Explicit binding policies / mappings and concise diagnostics should preserve the actual unmodified VMD data.
3. Add selected files with byte sizes and SHA-256 to the corresponding pinned allowlists: `tools/uka-manifest.json` and `tools/gene-light-manifest.json`. Reuse the existing verified fetch/build flow, not ad-hoc live upstream fetching at runtime.

### Public side-by-side runtime

4. Modify `examples/main.ts` and minimal public UI in `examples/index.html` for a shared **Motion** selector and compact Play/Pause, Restart, timeline seek and Loop controls. Keep current exact viewport headings **MMD** / **glTF**, synchronized camera, model selector, mobile stacked layout and collapsible credits. Avoid restoring the verbose page copy removed in #59. Motion controls should reflect loading/errors and avoid looking operational before assets are ready.
5. LEFT: use the installed `@takahirox/three-mmd` `MMDLoader.loadAnimation()` / `MMDAnimationHelper` or equivalent supported APIs with the selected original PMX and VMD. Set `physics:false`, disable `ik`, and disable `grant`/append for the first-phase raw-motion comparison. No Ammo/Bullet initialization or physics world is permitted in this flow.
6. RIGHT: generate/load glTF for the corresponding model with **core BDEF skinning plus matching bound VMD**, retaining its exact VMD transport where feasible (`MMD_animation_vmd` v6 and `MMDVMDPlugin` / `VMDPlayer`). Set solver/physics execution to none; do not accidentally double-run ordinary fallback channels and exact retained playback. Use a compatible skinned conversion for Gene Light: `tools/prepare-example.ts` currently calls `convertModel(...)` in default **static** mode for Gene, whereas Uka's `tools/prepare-uka.ts` uses `mode:'bdef'`. Preserve existing material/outline appearance, original textures and attribution.
7. Existing preview optimizations affect animation: `examples/main.ts` currently strips all Gene morph GPU attributes and narrows Uka to blink/smile, renaming targets. Adjust the preview as needed for the selected bound VMD controls; **do not remove/relabel active motion targets so tracks silently fail**. Preserve the full downloadable conversion and avoid blindly uploading every large morph buffer; profile and bound resource use. Do not change the underlying converter or transport semantics just for the demo.
8. Drive both sides by one explicit canonical time/frame source (VMD frame/30 seconds), with synchronized play/pause/seek/loop/restore. Prevent independent animation clocks or stale motion actions on model/motion switch, suspended views, and disposal. Frame-rate dependence must not create accumulating clock drift. Motion selection must coexist cleanly with manual expression selection: no double-writing morph weights.
9. State genuinely unsupported subsets (material/group/bone/UV morph, VMD visibility controls, unresolved names) accurately in collapsed About & credits and diagnostics, not prominent prose. Avoid pretending the two engines implement every MMD behavior identically.

### Verification

10. Add real-asset browser tests, including one Uka and one Gene representative motion, to `tests/browser/uka.spec.ts`, `tests/browser/example.spec.ts` and/or `tests/browser/unified-demo.spec.ts`. Verify both panes load and show **changed rendered pixels** at two chosen nontrivial sample times, corresponding/restored pixels after restart, seek/loop synchronization, pause freeze, and model-switch cleanup. Assert IK/physics are not initialized or executed.
11. Verify the selected VMD is actually being bound (nonzero useful bone/morph tracks), compare track coverage rather than just checking that a clip/player exists. Include failures for unavailable, corrupted or unmatched VMD with clear status and retry.
12. Keep current Toon/PBR, Outline, camera, viewport mobile 390px, Back-navigation and credits tests passing. Validate `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, applicable `npm run test:browser`, `npm run check:links`, and `git diff --check`.

## Important existing code and evidence

- [Current comparison loader](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/main.ts): line ~138 explicitly says "No helper, mixer, IK or physics"; scene renders fixed pose. Public controls in [examples/index.html](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/index.html).
- [Uka asset preparation](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/prepare-uka.ts): source is BDEF, generates static-pose `model.gltf`, allows only one currently inventoried VMD. The motion isn't played.
- [Gene asset preparation](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/prepare-example.ts): current Gene glTF conversion is static, and its allowlist contains no VMD.
- LEFT reference runtime: [MMDLoader](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts) supports `loadAnimation`; [MMDAnimationHelper](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDAnimationHelper.ts) supports `physics:false` and `enable('ik'|'grant',false)`.
- RIGHT runtime: [three-mmd-vmd](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/three-mmd-vmd/index.ts), [VMD transport/source-preservation documentation](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/source-transport.md). Use the exact extension player rather than applying the matching core fallback concurrently.
- Existing real-world Uka audit: [docs/uka.md](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/uka.md). Source inventory reports that the old shared `03_smile.vmd` has 129/222 bone names and 37/111 morph names unmatched to Uka: do not choose it solely because it is already pinned.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Public Uka and Gene comparisons each offer **at least one** verified matching official VMD motion with enough mapped bone/morph tracks to produce demonstrable animation.
- [ ] Both panes respond to the same time/seek/play/pause/loop/stop actions, with independently drawn and visibly changing model pixels and reproducible restarts.
- [ ] No IK, grant/append, or physics execution is activated in either pane; no Ammo initialization is required for the public animation comparison.
- [ ] The Uka and Gene VMD files are pinned, hash-verified, attributable, and their actual name mapping/omissions documented. No misleading claim that a shared or mismatched VMD is Uka-specific.
- [ ] The right pane uses a skinned glTF animation path (not a static-only Gene GLB), without double-running fallback/core channels; targeted morph data remains valid and the full downloadable asset is unchanged or regenerated with documented changes.
- [ ] Existing comparisons, responsive layout, status/error handling, source rights and internal synthetic conformance UI remain functional.
- [ ] Source/binding and rendered browser regressions and required build/test/link checks pass; report skips and unresolved feature fidelity without claiming original-MMD equivalence.

## Optional validation

Manually inspect before/after desktop and mobile synchronized animation of the selected pinned motions, capture sample clips/screenshots, and compare pose transforms at selected VMD frames. This stage is expressly *not* an IK/physics or original-MMD parity benchmark.

## Required post-merge verification

None required (unless the implementer introduces an explicitly merge-triggered behavior that needs verification).
